❌ Two-factor Modal exists but calls non-existent service methods
known_issues: 🔴 CRITICAL: settingsService.js missing 3 2FA methods:
- setupTwoFactor() - should call POST /me/settings/security/two-factor/setup
- confirmTwoFactor(code) - should call POST /me/settings/security/two-factor/confirm
- disableTwoFactor() - should call DELETE /me/settings/security/two-factor
⚠️ TwoFactorModal calls undefined functions → Runtime error when enabling 2FA
⚠️ 2FA modal shows placeholder flow only (no actual QR code or TOTP setup)
⚠️ Backend password validation should check current password before allowing update
⚠️ No email verification when changing email address
missing_features: ❌ Session management (view active sessions, logout others)

priority_fixes.details: Add setupTwoFactor(), confirmTwoFactor(), disableTwoFactor() controller methods

priority_fixes.issue: Add email verification on email change
priority_fixes.impact: Security - prevent account takeover via email change
Security - users can see active sessions and logout from them

key_tables: ✅ users (user_id PK, username, email, password, phone_number)
✅ profiles (user_id FK, first_name, last_name, location, birthday, gender, description, profile_picture)
✅ posts (post_id PK, user_id FK, type enum(text|quote|image), privacy, content, image)
✅ communities (community_id PK, category_id FK, user_id FK, name, description, image)
✅ community_members (user_id FK, community_id FK, joined_at, unique constraint)
✅ comments (comment_id PK, post_id FK, user_id FK, parent_id FK, content)
✅ likes (like_id PK, post_id FK, user_id FK, unique constraint)
✅ notifications (notification_id PK, user_id FK, type, data, is_read)
✅ settings (user_id PK, default_post_privacy, hide_comments, show_reaction_counts, notify_likes, notify_comments, email_notifications, two_factor_enabled)
relationship_notes: ✅ User::UPDATED_AT = null - intentional for audit trail (no profile update time)
✅ Post model - uses 'post_id' primary key (non-standard but consistent)

flow: 1. HomePage: ComposerModal collects text/quote/image with type
2. postService.createPost() -> POST /api/posts with { type, content, mood_id, community_id, privacy }
4. Backend: Stores post with type enum, returns with relations loaded
5. Frontend: PostContent renders based on post.type (conditional rendering)

critical: SettingsPage (Security tab) - 🔴 Missing 2FA service methods block 2FA flow
medium: HomePage - ⚠️ No WebSocket real-time (polling workaround in place)
ProfilePage - ⚠️ Profile picture should use file upload, not URL text
low: JournalPage - ⚠️ No pagination for large journal collections

deployment_recommendations: 1. Implement 2FA service methods and backend endpoints (1-2 hours)
2. Test 2FA flow end-to-end with authenticator app
3. Add email verification for email changes
4. Enable WebSocket for real-time notifications (optional but recommended)
5. Fix profile picture upload to accept files instead of URLs
6. Add automated tests for critical flows
